nodes.title: Echo speak

params.name: voice
params.label: Voice
params.help: The saved voice it speaks in: an echo starter voice or a designed voice.

nodes.help: Fake speech: a WAV (24 kHz, PCM 16-bit, mono) of one sine tone per character, 1/15 s each (so it lasts exactly the planned seconds), its pitch from the character and the voice, its phase from the seed; one progress step per 15 characters. An empty text fails `<node>: nothing to say`.
